verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago offers automation-adjacent features: recurring subscriptions, webhook configuration, a CLI and an MCP server. None of the evidence documents versioning, reviewing or rolling back automations. Because a developer platform could plausibly ship this, the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes the verdict none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
